# Heron Mobile Release Train

Heron is the release process for the iOS and Android apps.

## Cadence

A release train leaves every second Wednesday. Features that miss the train wait for the next one.

## Phased rollout

Each release rolls out in phases: 1 percent, 10 percent, 50 percent and finally 100 percent of users over 7 days.

## Release gate

The rollout only advances while crash-free sessions stay at or above 99.6 percent. If crash-free sessions drop below that threshold, the rollout is paused automatically and the release captain is paged.
